desc: Built to perform under various conditions, the M&P 15 AXE rifles are as versatile as they are reliable. Leveraging Gemtech's GVAC upper, the M&P 15 AXE Rifle mitigates gas blowback in the face when running suppressed. This lightweight and rugged rifle embodies the best combination of function and form. Engineered for a wide variety of uses, the M&P15 platform is as versatile as it is reliable. The bolt release, magazine catch, and manual thumb safety are ready for both right-hand and left-hand users. Suppressor optimized upper that helps mitigate gas blowback in the face of the shooter when running suppressed.
